obernants.domain: Finite byte slices and ordinary terminating executions with successful allocation.
obernants.assumptions: Rust byte-slice semantics and successful allocation; transformation premises as stated.
obernants.observation_scope: One public call or explicitly scoped internal state.
obernants.operator: Exclude missing or spurious occurrences, duplicate reports of the same (end,pattern), out-of-range offsets, wrong byte spans, changed inputs, and an output not ordered by (end,pattern). Empty-pattern omissions and deduplication of equal pattern values are outside the contract.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived relation; bounded checks are not universal proofs.

obernants.domain: Finite byte slices and ordinary terminating executions with successful allocation.
obernants.assumptions: Rust byte-slice semantics and successful allocation; transformation premises as stated.
obernants.observation_scope: One public call or explicitly scoped internal state.
obernants.operator: For fixed patterns P and length n, restrict R to valid pattern IDs and ranges 0<=s<=e<=n, unique (end,pattern) pairs, and canonical increasing (end,pattern) order. Such an output R admits exactly byte texts T of length n for which each (i,s,e) in R has e-s=|P_i| and T[s..e]=P_i, and every matching span is in R. These positive and negative span constraints generally admit several texts; no unique reconstruction is claimed.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived relation; bounded checks are not universal proofs.

obernants.operator: After consuming T[..e], state represents the longest suffix of T[..e] which is a trie prefix. Compatible histories are precisely histories with this longest-prefix-suffix property, not histories with only the same final byte.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived relation; bounded checks are not universal proofs.

obernants.observation_scope: One public call or explicitly scoped internal state.
obernants.operator: Outputs at a state are exactly IDs whose patterns are suffixes of that state's trie label. Each pattern ID occurs once; distinct IDs with equal bytes coexist. Root outputs are exactly empty IDs.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Source-derived relation; bounded checks are not universal proofs.
